# Project instructions for Hola Guinea

- Verify project requirements before editing.
- Keep the Flask app modular and production-oriented.
- Follow the requested architecture: Flask + SQLAlchemy + Flask-Login + Flask-WTF + Pillow + pywebpush + Leaflet.
- Prefer clean, commented code and real PWA patterns.
- Use SQLite as the default database in development.
- Keep security practices in mind: HTTPS, file validation, CSRF, login protection, and safe cache strategies.
- Create placeholder assets when needed and replace them later with real branding assets.
